notes:
Replication values are author-derived primary project-table values, not independently converted. Original full HTML author-uploaded paper verified. No single original pooled effect is printed; es.value left null instead of computing a pooled correlation. Printed components: age-18 NEM with age-21 abuse: .19* (.21*); age-26 concurrent abuse: .28* (.29*). Parentheses denote partial correlations controlling gender and same/new partner. All listed component tests have p < .01. No individual narrative success verdict located; numeric success coding is not treated as narrative.
